description: Complete rewrite of /projects/sandbox/ms/LTX.PY as a 10-cell Google Colab notebook implementing the LTX Studio Infinite Flow Engine pipeline. This is a single large feature because all cells are interdependent and must be written together as one coherent file.
steps: Read the existing reference files to understand patterns: /projects/sandbox/ms/LTX_PRO.py (Cell 1-2 environment/downloads, Cell 3 imports/helpers, Cell 7 generate_pro), /projects/sandbox/ms/LTX2_InfiniteFlow_12Scene.py (VisionDescribeEngine, EasyPromptEngine, CharacterBible, generate_clip, InfiniteFlowEngine), /projects/sandbox/ms/LTX_Studio_Pipeline.py (StudioProductionEngine, scene schema, motion/camera/voice systems, configuration)

Write Cell 1 (Environment Setup): Copy from LTX_PRO.py Cell 1 exactly - installs torch, ComfyUI pinned branch, all custom nodes (KJNodes, GGUF, LTXVideo, LTX2EasyPrompt-LD, LTX2-Master-Loader, VideoHelperSuite), node requirements, apt packages, PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF. Use !pip and %cd Colab magic.

Write Cell 2 (Model Downloads): Copy from LTX_PRO.py Cell 2 - aria2c download helper, downloads LTX-2 19B GGUF Q4_K_M, Gemma fp4 text encoder, embeddings connector, video VAE, audio VAE, TAE VAE, spatial upscaler, all IC LoRAs (Detailer/Canny/Depth/Pose) and Camera LoRAs (Dolly-In/Out/Left/Right, Jib-Up/Down, Static).

Write Cell 3 (Core Imports & Utilities): Include VRAM management (aggressive_cleanup, _vram_free, _vram_print, _vram_guard), tensor helpers (pil_to_tensor, tensor_to_pil, load_image_tensor, get_last_frame_tensor), video helpers (display_video, save_video_obj, concatenate_clips), ComfyUI async node loader (_load_comfy_nodes), audio VAE loader (_audio_vae). Follow patterns from LTX_Studio_Pipeline.py Cell 3.

Write Cell 4 (Character Bible & Consistency System): CharacterBible class with add(), extract_from_description(), to_prompt_block(), save(), load() methods. VisionDescribeEngine class (standalone Qwen2.5-VL) with MODEL_OPTIONS dict and describe() method that loads/describes/unloads. Character profile extraction from story text. Follow LTX2_InfiniteFlow_12Scene.py SECTION A and C.

Write Cell 5 (Easy Prompt Engine): EasyPromptEngine class with MODELS dict (3B/8B/14B), SYSTEM_PROMPT enforcing present tense, 8-12 sentences, priority order (style>camera>character>env>action>camera_movement>audio), _CLEAN_RE regex list, _load/_unload/_stop_ids/_clean methods, generate() method with pacing control, character_bible lock injection, mandatory keywords append ('Ultra HDR, 3D intricate details, vibrant colors, realistic lighting, Dramatic Lighting, Enhanced Clarity, Brilliant Highlights, Hyperrealistic Detailing, cinematic'). Include _build_neg() negative prompt builder. Follow LTX2_InfiniteFlow_12Scene.py SECTION B.

Write Cell 6 (SVI-Pro Infinite Flow Engine): InfiniteFlowEngine class with __init__ accepting CharacterBible/engines/config, CAMERA_LORA_MAPPING dict (dolly_forward/backward/left/right, pan_left/right, tilt_up/down, zoom_in/out, static), _build_lora_stack() helper, _apply_loras() with LTX2MasterLoaderLD + manual fallback, calculate_adaptive_strength() based on motion change, enhanced_anchor_extraction() with brightness+sharpness scoring, run() method implementing SVI-Pro anchor chaining pattern (generate clip N, extract last OVERLAP_FRAMES frames as anchor, use as seed for N+1, adaptive strength), cache-based resume, progress tracking with time estimates, retry logic (3 attempts, progressive frame reduction on OOM), final ffmpeg concatenation. Follow LTX_Studio_Pipeline.py StudioProductionEngine pattern.

Write Cell 7 (generate_clip Function): Two-pass LTX-2 pipeline. MUST use CLIP-first-then-UNet pattern: Step 1 Load CLIP (DualCLIPLoader) -> CLIPTextEncode -> ConditioningZeroOut -> LTXVConditioning -> DELETE clip_raw -> _vram_free(). Step 2 Load UNet (UnetLoaderGGUF) -> apply LoRAs. Step 3 Load VAE + audio VAE + upscaler. Step 4 Prepare latents (EmptyImage -> ResizeImageMaskNode x0.5 -> GetImageSize -> EmptyLTXVLatentVideo). I2V branch: ResizeImageMaskNode with 'scale dimensions' + ResizeImagesByLongerEdge.EXECUTE_NORMALIZED + LTXVPreprocess(img_compression=33) + LTXVImgToVideoInplace. Audio: LTXVEmptyLatentAudio + LTXVConcatAVLatent. Step 5 Pass 1 (ManualSigmas + euler + CFGGuider + SamplerCustomAdvanced). Step 6 Pass 2 (LTXVSeparateAVLatent + LTXVCropGuides + LTXVLatentUpsampler + gradient_estimation) -> DELETE UNet. Step 7 Decode (LTXVSpatioTemporalTiledVAEDecode or VAEDecode fallback) + LTXVAudioVAEDecode -> DELETE VAEs. Step 8 Save via CreateVideo + save_video_obj. Follow LTX_Studio_Pipeline.py generate_clip() and LTX2_InfiniteFlow_12Scene.py generate_clip().

Write Cell 8 (Configuration): ALL settings with # @param annotations. Project: PROJECT_NAME(string), WIDTH(integer), HEIGHT(integer), FPS(integer), FRAMES(integer). AI Engine: LLM_MODEL(dropdown 3B/8B/14B), VISION_MODEL(dropdown 3B-fast/7B-nsfw), CREATIVITY(number), USE_VISION(boolean). Continuity: OVERLAP_FRAMES(integer), ANCHOR_STRENGTH_HIGH(number), ANCHOR_STRENGTH_LOW(number), USE_ADAPTIVE_STRENGTH(boolean). LoRA: IC_LORA(dropdown none/detailer/canny/depth/pose), IC_LORA_STRENGTH(number), CAMERA_LORA_STRENGTH(number). Memory: USE_TILED_VAE(boolean), TILED_SPATIAL_TILES(integer), TILED_TEMPORAL_LEN(integer). Character: CHARACTER_IMAGE_PATH(string), CHARACTER_STRENGTH(number). Sampling: PASS1_SIGMAS(string), PASS2_SIGMAS(string), PASS1_SAMPLER(string), PASS2_SAMPLER(string). Output: OUTPUT_DIR(string), SHOW_PREVIEWS(boolean), DOWNLOAD_AFTER_GENERATE(boolean). Seed: BASE_SEED(integer), AUTO_INCREMENT_SEED(boolean).

Write Cell 9 (Story Input & Scene Definition): STORY_INPUT text area, parse_story_to_scenes() function that uses EasyPromptEngine to analyse story (environment, genre, mood), extract character profiles, break into scenes with camera/motion/dialogue, generate per-scene prompts with character bible lock + mandatory keywords. Include the Whispering Cave 12-shot storyboard as default EXAMPLE_SCENE_JSON (same as in LTX_Studio_Pipeline.py Cell 8).

Write Cell 10 (Run Production): Instantiate CharacterBible, VisionDescribeEngine, EasyPromptEngine. If CHARACTER_IMAGE_PATH provided, auto-populate bible from vision. Build storyboard from parsed scenes. Run InfiniteFlowEngine with retry logic. Final ffmpeg concatenation. Summary report. Display final video. Include error handling for OOM, missing nodes, and general exceptions with helpful fix suggestions.
